dialogues.jp: 暦先生が教室を見回し、出欠を確認する。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei glanced around the room, taking the
attendance.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei glanced around the room, taking the
attendance.

dialogues.jp:
微かに話し声のする、いつもの穏やかな朝の日
常。
dialogues.en:
Muffled voices could be heard from students, an ordinary
school morning.
dialogues.text:
Muffled voices could be heard from students, an ordinary
school morning.

dialogues.jp:
今朝は連絡事項もなく、出欠だけをすませ、暦
先生が出て行く。
dialogues.en:
There weren't any special announcements today, so after
taking attendance, Koyomi-sensei left the room.
dialogues.text:
There weren't any special announcements today, so after
taking attendance, Koyomi-sensei left the room.

dialogues.jp: 途端に教室内はざわめき、俺は｛あくび／欠伸｝をした。
dialogues.en:
In an instant, the noise level of the classroom rose several
notches, as I stretched back and yawned.
dialogues.text:
In an instant, the noise level of the classroom rose several
notches, as I stretched back and yawned.

dialogues.jp:
連絡事項も特に無く、出欠の確認をすると、暦
先生はさっさと教室を出て行ってしまった。
dialogues.en:
With no special announcements, after confirming the
attendance, Koyomi quickly left the classroom.
dialogues.text:
With no special announcements, after confirming the
attendance, Koyomi quickly left the classroom.
